headline: HBR Realty sells assets to real estate fund for nearly R$ 1 billion
summary: HBR Realty has signed contracts to sell stakes in four real estate projects to the SPX Portfólio Alfa fund for R$ 937.7 million.
why: Asset divestments are common in the real estate sector to improve liquidity and optimize portfolios. This transaction is a significant capital event for the involved parties.

impacts.name: HBR Realty
impacts.why: Significant cash inflow from asset sales improves the company's balance sheet.
